title: NitroMC
description: A Minecraft Modpack purely focused on getting the most out of your hardware! Entirely uses performance focused mods, and maybe even some you've never heard of! ^^
body:
# NitroMC - the future of fps modpacks!

Introducing **high fps on a fine-tuned level**, offering **much higher fps than vanilla** with **zero compromises** with just **3 optimization mods!** Supports only the **client side** of Minecraft. NitroMC is available for all operating systes with java 21 and a OS and CPU with 64-bit support, making it **perfect for almost anybody**! and the best thing is: **you dont really have to deal with the config!** it's all already done by me! ;)

For any **comments/improvement ideas** please contact eli@txt3.de

PS: use these JVM Args for a little more performance!:

-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:+UseLargePages -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:+DisableExplicitGC

Also set you RAM alocation to -Xms (a quarter of your total RAM) and -Xmx (half your total RAM, but avoid anything over 8G)
